title: EventBus callback exception broadcast isolation contract

contract.callback_exception_isolation: An exception raised by one listener callback does not propagate out of EventBus.emit()
contract.broadcast_continuity: EventBus.emit() continues successfully despite a callback failure during broadcast
contract.listener_delivery: The failing listener receives the event and subsequent listeners continue receiving the same event
contract.delivery_success: All registered listeners receive the emitted event exactly once in the observed scenario
contract.emit_result: EventBus.emit() returns True after the callback exception
contract.registry_integrity: A callback exception does not modify or corrupt the listener registry
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: Event emission and listener registration require the events permission
